integrity: Proof and independent finite enumerator supplied; no independent external mathematical review or validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for simple crown graphs of order 2n with n>=3, labeled q-palettes q>=0. Does not extend to general bipartite graphs or independently establish the preexisting minimum distinguishing chromatic number. Earlier differently indexed equivalent enumeration is an originality risk.
title: Exact proper distinguishing-coloring enumerator of crown graphs and the mixed-palette threshold
